item.title: Already Running a Plex Server? You Don't Need Google Photos Anymore
item.description: Google Photos keeps shrinking your free storage and your private memories are sitting on someone else’s server. If you’re already running Plex, you’re closer to fixing both of those problems than you think.

item.title: HDD vs SSD: What's the Difference and Which One Do You Need?
item.description: Hard drives are cheap. SSDs are fast. But which one actually makes sense for your situation? Here’s the honest breakdown — no jargon, no fluff.

item.title: How Much RAM Do You Actually Need?
item.description: 8GB, 16GB, 32GB — the options are everywhere and the marketing makes all of it sound necessary. Here’s what you actually need based on what you actually do.

item.title: RAM Is Expensive Right Now — Here's How to Not Get Ripped Off
item.description: RAM prices are up and the reasons behind it aren’t great. Here’s what’s driving the cost and exactly how to shop smart so you’re not overpaying.

item.title: Should You Repair or Replace Your Old PC?
item.description: Your PC is slow, something broke, or it just feels done. Before you spend money in either direction, here’s how to figure out which one actually makes sense.

item.title: What Happens If You Never Clean Your PC?
item.description: Dust doesn’t just make your PC look dirty — it quietly destroys it from the inside. Here’s what’s actually happening in there and how to stop it.

item.title: What Is Plex and Why Every Media Lover Needs It
item.description: Plex turns your computer into your own personal Netflix — free, no subscriptions, and you own everything on it. Here’s what it is and why you’ll wish you’d set it up sooner.

item.title: Is Your PC Too Slow? Here's Why (And How to Fix It)
item.description: A slow PC is frustrating — but the fix is usually simpler than you think. Here are the most common causes and exactly what to do about them.
